Metin2 DX9Ex: before and after

A source-code review of the graphics reliability and geometry-buffer fixes. Previous code is on the left; fixed code is on the right.

BASELINE 1ee24e546d3a4e3d465c722cb7c5cb0220b8bff4 · REVIEWED COMMIT 6e88ff5257f235ba406d57cc7b015f950fed28a3 · 38 changed files

Changes cover device lifecycle, texture uploads, shadows and previews, GPU state tracking, startup validation and geometry buffers. Validation: v10 self-test and user gameplay checks passed on NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti, driver 32.0.16.1692. Other GPUs remain unverified; CPU terrain remains deferred.

This is a snapshot of this source version. New helper files and the self-test are included. Individual snippets can depend on changes in other files; different Metin2 sources require adaptation. No external libraries, accounts or internet connection are needed to view this file.

17    template <typename Buffer>
18    bool Lock(Buffer* buffer, UINT bytes, void** output, DWORD flags = 0)
19    {
20        if (!output) return false;
21        *output = nullptr;
22        if (!buffer) return false;
23        void* data = nullptr;
24        if (FAILED(buffer->Lock(0, bytes, &data, flags))) return false;
25        if (!data) { buffer->Unlock(); return false; }
26        *output = data;
27        return true;
28    }

30    template <typename Buffer>
31    bool Copy(Buffer* buffer, DWORD capacity, int bytes, const void* source)
32    {
33        if (!source || bytes <= 0 || static_cast<DWORD>(bytes) > capacity) return false;
34        void* target = nullptr;
35        // Copy always writes, regardless of the resource's usage flags.
36        if (!Lock(buffer, static_cast<UINT>(bytes), &target)) return false;
37        std::memcpy(target, source, static_cast<size_t>(bytes));
38        return SUCCEEDED(buffer->Unlock());
39    }

6// Single render thread / single device, like CGraphicBase. A failed restoration
7// invalidates drawing until device teardown; ResetEx cannot reconcile the cache.
8class CGraphicsRestoreStatus
9{
10public:
11    static CGraphicsRestoreStatus& Instance()
12    {
13        static CGraphicsRestoreStatus status;
14        return status;
15    }
16    bool IsBlocked() const { return FAILED(m_result); }
17    HRESULT Result() const { return m_result; }
18    const char* Operation() const { return m_operation; }
19    // Operation must be a string literal. Preserve the first failure through all
20    // subsequent cleanup calls, including successful EndScene/state-block Apply.
21    void Record(HRESULT result, const char* operation)
22    {
23        if (SUCCEEDED(result) || IsBlocked()) return;
24        m_result = result;
25        m_operation = operation;
26        TraceError("Graphics: restoration failed in %s (HRESULT=0x%08lX); drawing blocked, restart required.",
27            operation, static_cast<unsigned long>(result));
28    }
29    // Device construction/teardown only. Never clear at BeginScene or ResetEx.
30    void ResetForDeviceLifetime() { m_result = S_OK; m_operation = "none"; }
31private:
32    HRESULT m_result = S_OK;
33    const char* m_operation = "none";
34};

38    // Shared with the controlled backend in the standalone test. Always attempt

45        {
46            status.Record(result, operation);
47            if (FAILED(result) && SUCCEEDED(first)) first = result;
48        };

52        check(backend.RestoreViewport(), "Restore viewport");

197    TDecodedImageData Pattern(int width, int height, unsigned seed)
198    {
199        TDecodedImageData image;
200        image.width = width;
201        image.height = height;
202        image.format = TDecodedImageData::FORMAT_RGBA8;
203        image.pixels.resize(static_cast<size_t>(width) * height * 4);
204        const uint8_t alpha[] = {0, 128, 255};
205        for (int y = 0; y < height; ++y)
206            for (int x = 0; x < width; ++x)
207            {
208                uint8_t* pixel = image.pixels.data() + (static_cast<size_t>(y) * width + x) * 4;
209                pixel[0] = static_cast<uint8_t>(x * 37 + y * 17 + seed * 11);
210                pixel[1] = static_cast<uint8_t>(x * 13 + y * 53 + seed * 7 + 61);
211                pixel[2] = static_cast<uint8_t>(x * 71 + y * 3 + seed * 29 + 127);
212                pixel[3] = alpha[(x + y + seed) % 3];
213            }
214        // Known primaries plus opaque magenta catch channel swaps, alpha changes,
215        // and accidental application of the file loader's magenta colour key.
216        const uint8_t anchors[][4] = {{255, 0, 0, 255}, {0, 255, 0, 128},
217            {0, 0, 255, 0}, {255, 0, 255, 255}};
218        for (size_t pixel = 0; pixel < 4 && pixel < image.pixels.size() / 4; ++pixel)
219            memcpy(image.pixels.data() + pixel * 4, anchors[pixel], 4);
220        return image;
221    }

223    // CPU-only backend for the SAME transaction used by the real uploader.
224    // No global fault controls, COM replacement, or deliberate driver failures.
225    class ControlledUploadBackend
226    {
227    public:
228        enum class Fault { None, Staging, Lock, NullBits, ZeroPitch, NegativePitch,
229            ShortPitch, Unlock, Destination, Update };
230        static constexpr size_t Guard = 16;
231        static constexpr uint8_t Canary = 0xCD;
232        struct Texture
233        {
234            UINT width = 0, height = 0;
235            int pitch = 0;
236            D3DPOOL pool = D3DPOOL_SYSTEMMEM;
237            bool locked = false;
238            std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
239        };
240        Fault fault = Fault::None;
241        int padding = 16;
242        unsigned creates = 0, locks = 0, unlocks = 0, updates = 0, releases = 0;
243        bool cleanupError = false;
244 
245        HRESULT Create(UINT width, UINT height, D3DPOOL pool, Texture** output)
246        {
247            ++creates;
248            *output = nullptr;
249            if (pool == D3DPOOL_SYSTEMMEM && fault == Fault::Staging) return E_OUTOFMEMORY;
250            if (pool == D3DPOOL_DEFAULT && fault == Fault::Destination) return D3DERR_OUTOFVIDEOMEMORY;
251            auto texture = std::make_unique<Texture>();
252            texture->width = width;
253            texture->height = height;
254            texture->pitch = static_cast<int>(width * 4) + padding;
255            texture->pool = pool;
256            texture->bytes.assign(Guard * 2 + static_cast<size_t>(texture->pitch) * height, Canary);
257            m_live.push_back(std::move(texture));
258            *output = m_live.back().get();
259            return S_OK;
260        }
261 
262        HRESULT Lock(Texture* texture, D3DLOCKED_RECT* locked)
263        {
264            ++locks;
265            Require(texture->pool == D3DPOOL_SYSTEMMEM && !texture->locked, "Invalid controlled lock sequence");
266            if (fault == Fault::Lock) return D3DERR_INVALIDCALL;
267            texture->locked = true;
268            locked->pBits = texture->bytes.data() + Guard;
269            locked->Pitch = texture->pitch;
270            if (fault == Fault::NullBits) locked->pBits = nullptr;
271            if (fault == Fault::ZeroPitch) locked->Pitch = 0;
272            if (fault == Fault::NegativePitch) locked->Pitch = -1;
273            if (fault == Fault::ShortPitch) locked->Pitch = static_cast<int>(texture->width * 4) - 1;
274            return S_OK;
275        }
276 
277        HRESULT Unlock(Texture* texture)
278        {
279            ++unlocks;
280            Require(texture->locked, "Unlock without a successful lock");
281            if (fault == Fault::Unlock) return E_FAIL;
282            texture->locked = false;
283            return S_OK;
284        }
285 
286        HRESULT Update(Texture* source, Texture* destination)
287        {
288            ++updates;
289            Require(!source->locked && source->pool == D3DPOOL_SYSTEMMEM &&
290                destination->pool == D3DPOOL_DEFAULT && source->width == destination->width &&
291                source->height == destination->height, "Invalid controlled update sequence");
292            if (fault == Fault::Update)
293            {
294                // A failed copy may have partially touched its destination.
295                destination->bytes[Guard] = 0;
296                return D3DERR_DEVICELOST;
297            }
298            for (UINT row = 0; row < source->height; ++row)
299                memcpy(destination->bytes.data() + Guard + static_cast<size_t>(row) * destination->pitch,
300                    source->bytes.data() + Guard + static_cast<size_t>(row) * source->pitch, source->width * 4);
301            return S_OK;
302        }
303 
304        bool GuardsIntact(const Texture& texture) const noexcept
305        {
306            for (size_t index = 0; index < texture.bytes.size(); ++index)
307            {
308                const bool outside = index < Guard || index >= texture.bytes.size() - Guard;
309                const bool paddingByte = !outside && (index - Guard) % texture.pitch >= texture.width * 4;
310                if ((outside || paddingByte) && texture.bytes[index] != Canary) return false;
311            }
312            return true;
313        }
314 
315        void Release(Texture* texture) noexcept
316        {
317            for (auto item = m_live.begin(); item != m_live.end(); ++item)
318                if (item->get() == texture)
319                {
320                    // A failed Unlock is followed by release, not another copy attempt.
321                    cleanupError |= !GuardsIntact(*texture) || (texture->locked && fault != Fault::Unlock);
322                    if (fault == Fault::NullBits || fault == Fault::ZeroPitch ||
323                        fault == Fault::NegativePitch || fault == Fault::ShortPitch)
324                        for (const auto byte : texture->bytes)
325                            cleanupError |= byte != Canary; // Invalid locks must cause no writes at all.
326                    ++releases;
327                    m_live.erase(item);
328                    return;
329                }
330            cleanupError = true; // Double release or a foreign handle.
331        }
332 
333        size_t LiveCount() const { return m_live.size(); }
334        void ResetCounters()
335        {
336            Require(m_live.empty() && !cleanupError, "Resources remained before retry");
337            creates = locks = unlocks = updates = releases = 0;
338        }
339    private:
340        // Own even leaked test handles so a failed assertion cannot leak the harness.
341        // LiveCount is checked BEFORE this fallback cleanup occurs.
342        std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Texture>> m_live;
343    };
344 
345    void VerifyControlledSuccess(ControlledUploadBackend& backend, const TDecodedImageData& image)
346    {
347        ControlledUploadBackend::Texture* output = nullptr;
348        Check(TextureUploadDetail::UploadRGBA8(backend, image, &output), "Controlled upload retry");
349        Require(output && backend.LiveCount() == 1 && backend.releases == 1,
350            "Success did not release staging and publish exactly one destination");
351        Require(backend.creates == 2 && backend.locks == 1 && backend.unlocks == 1 && backend.updates == 1,
352            "Unexpected successful upload sequence");
353        for (int y = 0; y < image.height; ++y)
354            for (int x = 0; x < image.width; ++x)
355            {
356                const uint8_t* pixel = image.pixels.data() + (static_cast<size_t>(y) * image.width + x) * 4;
357                const DWORD expected = D3DCOLOR_ARGB(pixel[3], pixel[0], pixel[1], pixel[2]);
358                DWORD actual = 0;
359                // memcpy also handles deliberately unaligned pitches such as 13 bytes.
360                memcpy(&actual, output->bytes.data() + ControlledUploadBackend::Guard +
361                    static_cast<size_t>(y) * output->pitch + x * 4, sizeof(actual));
362                Require(actual == expected, "Forced-pitch pixel mismatch");
363            }
364        Require(backend.GuardsIntact(*output), "Destination padding or guard was overwritten");
365        backend.Release(output);
366        Require(backend.LiveCount() == 0 && backend.releases == 2 && !backend.cleanupError,
367            "Controlled upload leaked a resource or overwrote staging padding/guards");
368    }
369 
370    void RunControlledCases(Report& report)
371    {
372        report.Write("RUN controlled CPU upload transaction tests (simulated API results, no GPU faults)");
373        for (const int width : {1, 3, 7, 257})
374            for (const int padding : {1, 4, 16})
375            {
376                ControlledUploadBackend backend;
377                backend.padding = padding;
378                VerifyControlledSuccess(backend, Pattern(width, 5, 9));
379                report.Write("PASS forced padding: %dx5, pitch=%d, padding=%d; pixels/guards/releases", width, width * 4 + padding, padding);
380            }
381 
382        using Fault = ControlledUploadBackend::Fault;
383        const struct { Fault fault; const char* name; HRESULT result; unsigned creates, locks, unlocks, updates, releases; } cases[] = {
384            {Fault::Staging, "staging allocation", E_OUTOFMEMORY, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0},
385            {Fault::Lock, "staging lock", D3DERR_INVALIDCALL, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1},
386            {Fault::NullBits, "null locked pixels", E_FAIL, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1},
387            {Fault::ZeroPitch, "zero pitch", E_FAIL, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1},
388            {Fault::NegativePitch, "negative pitch", E_FAIL, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1},
389            {Fault::ShortPitch, "pitch shorter than row", E_FAIL, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1},
390            {Fault::Unlock, "staging unlock", E_FAIL, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1},
391            {Fault::Destination, "destination allocation", D3DERR_OUTOFVIDEOMEMORY, 2, 1, 1, 0, 1},
392            {Fault::Update, "partially completed copy", D3DERR_DEVICELOST, 2, 1, 1, 1, 2}
393        };
394        const auto image = Pattern(3, 5, 7);
395        for (const auto& test : cases)
396        {
397            report.Write("RUN simulated failure: %s", test.name);
398            ControlledUploadBackend backend;
399            backend.fault = test.fault;
400            ControlledUploadBackend::Texture marker;
401            auto* output = &marker; // Must be cleared, even on the earliest failure.
402            const HRESULT result = TextureUploadDetail::UploadRGBA8(backend, image, &output);
403            Require(result == test.result, "Injected HRESULT was not preserved");
404            Require(output == nullptr && backend.LiveCount() == 0 && !backend.cleanupError,
405                "Failed upload published a partial texture, leaked handles, or damaged padding");
406            Require(backend.creates == test.creates && backend.locks == test.locks &&
407                backend.unlocks == test.unlocks && backend.updates == test.updates && backend.releases == test.releases,
408                "Upload continued after failure or skipped required cleanup");
409            backend.ResetCounters();
410            backend.fault = Fault::None;
411            VerifyControlledSuccess(backend, image);
412            report.Write("PASS simulated failure/retry: %s; HRESULT=0x%08lX; no live test resources", test.name, static_cast<unsigned long>(result));
413        }
414        report.Write("Controlled coverage: 12 forced-padding cases, 9 failure/invalid-lock cases with successful retries");
415    }
416 
417    // Unbind even when a check throws; each successful iteration relinquishes all
418    // test texture/target references before the next creation/destruction cycle.
419    class DrawBinding
420    {
421    public:
422        explicit DrawBinding(IDirect3DDevice9Ex* device) : m_device(device)
423        {
424            Check(device->GetRenderTarget(0, m_previous.GetAddressOf()), "GetRenderTarget");
425        }
426        ~DrawBinding()
427        {
428            if (m_active)
429            {
430                m_device->SetTexture(0, nullptr);
431                m_device->SetRenderTarget(0, m_previous.Get());
432            }
433        }
434        void Clear()
435        {
436            Check(m_device->SetTexture(0, nullptr), "Unbind texture");
437            Check(m_device->SetRenderTarget(0, m_previous.Get()), "Unbind render target");
438            m_active = false;
439        }
440    private:
441        IDirect3DDevice9Ex* m_device;
442        ComPtr<IDirect3DSurface9> m_previous;
443        bool m_active = true;
444    };
445 
446    int VerifyPixels(IDirect3DDevice9Ex* device, CGraphicImageTexture& texture,
447        const TDecodedImageData& image, Report& report)
448    {
449        Require(!texture.IsEmpty() && texture.GetD3DTexture(), "Upload returned no usable texture");
450        D3DSURFACE_DESC description = {};
451        Check(texture.GetD3DTexture()->GetLevelDesc(0, &description), "GetLevelDesc");
452        Require(description.Width == static_cast<UINT>(image.width) &&
453            description.Height == static_cast<UINT>(image.height) &&
454            description.Format == D3DFMT_A8R8G8B8 && description.Pool == D3DPOOL_DEFAULT &&
455            texture.GetD3DTexture()->GetLevelCount() == 1 &&
456            texture.GetWidth() == image.width && texture.GetHeight() == image.height,
457            "Uploaded texture does not match its dimensions/format/pool/level contract");
458        ComPtr<IDirect3DSurface9> target;
459        ComPtr<IDirect3DSurface9> readback;
460        Check(device->CreateRenderTarget(image.width, image.height, D3DFMT_A8R8G8B8,
461            D3DMULTISAMPLE_NONE, 0, FALSE, target.GetAddressOf(), nullptr), "CreateRenderTarget");
462        Check(device->CreateOffscreenPlainSurface(image.width, image.height, D3DFMT_A8R8G8B8,
463            D3DPOOL_SYSTEMMEM, readback.GetAddressOf(), nullptr), "Create readback surface");
464        DrawBinding binding(device);
465        Check(device->SetRenderTarget(0, target.Get()), "SetRenderTarget");
466        const D3DVIEWPORT9 viewport = {0, 0, static_cast<DWORD>(image.width),
467            static_cast<DWORD>(image.height), 0.0f, 1.0f};
468        Check(device->SetViewport(&viewport), "SetViewport");
469        Check(device->Clear(0, nullptr, D3DCLEAR_TARGET, 0x2468ACE0, 1.0f, 0), "Clear");
470        Check(device->SetTexture(0, texture.GetD3DTexture()), "SetTexture");
471        struct Vertex { float x, y, z, rhw, u, v; };
472        // D3D9 pixel centres lie on integers: offset the quad edges by half a pixel.
473        const float right = static_cast<float>(image.width) - 0.5f;
474        const float bottom = static_cast<float>(image.height) - 0.5f;
475        const Vertex vertices[] = {
476            {-0.5f, -0.5f, 0, 1, 0, 0}, {right, -0.5f, 0, 1, 1, 0},
477            {-0.5f, bottom, 0, 1, 0, 1}, {right, bottom, 0, 1, 1, 1}
478        };
479        Check(device->BeginScene(), "BeginScene");
480        const HRESULT draw = device->DrawPrimitiveUP(D3DPT_TRIANGLESTRIP, 2, vertices, sizeof(Vertex));
481        const HRESULT end = device->EndScene(); // Always end a successfully begun scene.
482        Check(draw, "DrawPrimitiveUP");
483        Check(end, "EndScene");
484        binding.Clear();
485        Check(device->GetRenderTargetData(target.Get(), readback.Get()), "GetRenderTargetData");
486        D3DLOCKED_RECT locked = {};
487        Check(readback->LockRect(&locked, nullptr, D3DLOCK_READONLY), "Lock readback");
488        bool matches = locked.pBits && locked.Pitch > 0 &&
489            static_cast<size_t>(locked.Pitch) >= static_cast<size_t>(image.width) * 4;
490        for (int y = 0; matches && y < image.height; ++y)
491            for (int x = 0; matches && x < image.width; ++x)
492            {
493                const uint8_t* expected = image.pixels.data() + (static_cast<size_t>(y) * image.width + x) * 4;
494                const uint8_t* actual = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(locked.pBits) +
495                    static_cast<size_t>(y) * locked.Pitch + x * 4;
496                matches = actual[0] == expected[2] && actual[1] == expected[1] &&
497                    actual[2] == expected[0] && actual[3] == expected[3];
498                if (!matches)
499                    report.Write("Mismatch at (%d,%d): expected RGBA=%u,%u,%u,%u; actual RGBA=%u,%u,%u,%u",
500                        x, y, expected[0], expected[1], expected[2], expected[3],
501                        actual[2], actual[1], actual[0], actual[3]);
502            }
503        Check(readback->UnlockRect(), "Unlock readback");
504        Require(matches, "GPU readback mismatch or invalid readback pitch");
505        return locked.Pitch;
506    }

508    void UploadAndVerify(IDirect3DDevice9Ex* device, CGraphicImageTexture& texture,
509        const TDecodedImageData& image, D3DFORMAT format, Report& report)
510    {
511        texture.SetFileName("graphics-self-test");
512        Require(texture.CreateFromDecodedData(image, format, D3DX_FILTER_NONE), "CreateFromDecodedData failed");
513        const int pitch = VerifyPixels(device, texture, image, report);
514        texture.Destroy();
515        Require(texture.IsEmpty() && !texture.GetD3DTexture() &&
516            texture.GetWidth() == 0 && texture.GetHeight() == 0, "Destroy left published texture state");
517        report.Write("PASS upload/render/readback/destroy %dx%d; readback pitch=%d", image.width, image.height, pitch);
518    }
519 
520    bool SupportsSize(const D3DCAPS9& caps, int width, int height)
521    {
522        if (static_cast<DWORD>(width) > caps.MaxTextureWidth || static_cast<DWORD>(height) > caps.MaxTextureHeight)
523            return false;
524        if ((caps.TextureCaps & D3DPTEXTURECAPS_SQUAREONLY) && width != height)
525            return false;
526        if (caps.MaxTextureAspectRatio &&
527            (static_cast<uint64_t>(width) > static_cast<uint64_t>(height) * caps.MaxTextureAspectRatio ||
528             static_cast<uint64_t>(height) > static_cast<uint64_t>(width) * caps.MaxTextureAspectRatio))
529            return false;
530        const bool nonPowerOfTwo = (width & (width - 1)) || (height & (height - 1));
531        return !nonPowerOfTwo || !(caps.TextureCaps & D3DPTEXTURECAPS_POW2) ||
532            (caps.TextureCaps & D3DPTEXTURECAPS_NONPOW2CONDITIONAL);
533    }
534 
535    void VerifyTargetState(IDirect3DDevice9Ex* device, IDirect3DSurface9* target,
536        IDirect3DSurface9* depth, const D3DVIEWPORT9& viewport)
537    {
538        ComPtr<IDirect3DSurface9> actualTarget, actualDepth;
539        D3DVIEWPORT9 actualViewport = {};
540        Check(device->GetRenderTarget(0, actualTarget.GetAddressOf()), "Verify target");
541        const HRESULT depthResult = device->GetDepthStencilSurface(actualDepth.GetAddressOf());
542        if (depth) Check(depthResult, "Verify depth");
543        else Require(depthResult == D3DERR_NOTFOUND, "Expected no depth buffer");
544        Check(device->GetViewport(&actualViewport), "Verify viewport");
545        Require(actualTarget.Get() == target && actualDepth.Get() == depth,
546            "Offscreen target/depth restoration mismatch");
547        Require(actualViewport.X == viewport.X && actualViewport.Y == viewport.Y &&
548            actualViewport.Width == viewport.Width && actualViewport.Height == viewport.Height &&
549            actualViewport.MinZ == viewport.MinZ && actualViewport.MaxZ == viewport.MaxZ,
550            "Offscreen viewport restoration mismatch");
551    }
552 
553    void RunTargetBindingCases(IDirect3DDevice9Ex* device, Report& report)
554    {
555        report.Write("RUN offscreen target/depth/viewport restoration");
556        ComPtr<IDirect3DSurface9> originalTarget, depth, shadowTarget, invalidTarget;
557        Check(device->GetRenderTarget(0, originalTarget.GetAddressOf()), "Get test back buffer");
558        Check(device->CreateDepthStencilSurface(64, 64, D3DFMT_D16, D3DMULTISAMPLE_NONE,
559            0, TRUE, depth.GetAddressOf(), nullptr), "Create test depth");
560        Check(device->CreateRenderTarget(32, 32, D3DFMT_X8R8G8B8, D3DMULTISAMPLE_NONE,
561            0, FALSE, shadowTarget.GetAddressOf(), nullptr), "Create offscreen test target");
562        Check(device->CreateOffscreenPlainSurface(32, 32, D3DFMT_X8R8G8B8, D3DPOOL_SYSTEMMEM,
563            invalidTarget.GetAddressOf(), nullptr), "Create deliberately invalid binding target");
564        const D3DVIEWPORT9 custom = {3, 5, 41, 37, 0.125f, 0.875f};
565        const D3DVIEWPORT9 inset = {1, 1, 30, 30, 0.0f, 1.0f};
566        for (const bool withDepth : {false, true})
567        {
568            Check(device->SetDepthStencilSurface(withDepth ? depth.Get() : nullptr), "Set initial test depth");
569            Check(device->SetViewport(&custom), "Set initial custom viewport");
570            {
571                CRenderTargetBinding binding;
572                Check(binding.Restore(), "Inactive restore");
573                VerifyTargetState(device, originalTarget.Get(), withDepth ? depth.Get() : nullptr, custom);
574                report.Write("RUN expected binding failure: SYSTEMMEM plain surface is not a render target");
575                Require(FAILED(binding.Bind(device, invalidTarget.Get(), depth.Get(), inset)) && !binding.IsActive(),
576                    "Invalid target accepted or failed bind remained active");
577                VerifyTargetState(device, originalTarget.Get(), withDepth ? depth.Get() : nullptr, custom);
578                Check(binding.Bind(device, shadowTarget.Get(), depth.Get(), inset), "Bind offscreen pass");
579                VerifyTargetState(device, shadowTarget.Get(), depth.Get(), inset);
580                Require(binding.Bind(device, shadowTarget.Get(), depth.Get(), inset) == D3DERR_INVALIDCALL,
581                    "Nested bind on the same owner was accepted");
582                Check(binding.Restore(), "Restore offscreen pass");
583                Check(binding.Restore(), "Repeated restore");
584                VerifyTargetState(device, originalTarget.Get(), withDepth ? depth.Get() : nullptr, custom);
585                Check(binding.Bind(device, shadowTarget.Get(), depth.Get(), inset), "Bind before destructor restore");
586            }
587            VerifyTargetState(device, originalTarget.Get(), withDepth ? depth.Get() : nullptr, custom);
588            report.Write("PASS shared binding: original depth=%s; failed-bind rollback, custom viewport, duplicate bind/restore, destructor cleanup",
589                withDepth ? "present" : "absent");
590            {
591                CGraphicRenderTargetTexture preview;
592                Require(preview.Create(16, 16, D3DFMT_X8R8G8B8, D3DFMT_D16), "Create production preview target");
593                Require(!preview.Clear(), "Inactive preview Clear was accepted");
594                preview.ResetRenderTarget();
595                VerifyTargetState(device, originalTarget.Get(), withDepth ? depth.Get() : nullptr, custom);
596                Require(preview.SetRenderTarget(), "Bind production preview");
597                Require(!preview.SetRenderTarget(), "Duplicate preview bind was accepted");
598                Require(preview.Clear(), "Clear production preview");
599                preview.ResetRenderTarget();
600                VerifyTargetState(device, originalTarget.Get(), withDepth ? depth.Get() : nullptr, custom);
601                Require(preview.SetRenderTarget(), "Rebind production preview");
602                preview.ReleaseTextures(); // Must restore before releasing active resources.
603                Require(!preview.IsReady(), "Released preview remains ready");
604                VerifyTargetState(device, originalTarget.Get(), withDepth ? depth.Get() : nullptr, custom);
605                Require(preview.CreateTextures() && preview.SetRenderTarget(), "Recreate production preview");
606            }
607            VerifyTargetState(device, originalTarget.Get(), withDepth ? depth.Get() : nullptr, custom);
608            report.Write("PASS production preview: original depth=%s; bind/clear/restore, release/recreate, destructor cleanup",
609                withDepth ? "present" : "absent");
610        }
611        Check(device->SetDepthStencilSurface(nullptr), "Release test depth binding");
612        report.Write("Offscreen coverage: 2 shared-binding cases, 2 production-preview cases; real GPU");
613    }

615    void RunControlledRestoreCases(Report& report)
616    {
617        report.Write("RUN controlled restoration failures (simulated HRESULTs; no driver faults)");
618        struct Backend
619        {
620            int failStep;
621            HRESULT failure;
622            unsigned visited = 0;
623            HRESULT Step(unsigned step)
624            {
625                Require(visited == step, "Restoration order changed");
626                ++visited;
627                return failStep == static_cast<int>(step) ? failure : S_OK;
628            }
629            HRESULT DetachDepth() { return Step(0); }
630            HRESULT RestoreTarget() { return Step(1); }
631            HRESULT RestoreDepth() { return Step(2); }
632            HRESULT RestoreViewport() { return Step(3); }
633        };
634        const HRESULT failures[] = {E_FAIL, D3DERR_INVALIDCALL, D3DERR_DEVICELOST,
635            D3DERR_DEVICEHUNG, D3DERR_DEVICEREMOVED, E_OUTOFMEMORY};
636        for (const HRESULT failure : failures)
637        {
638            for (int step = 0; step < 4; ++step)
639            {
640                CGraphicsRestoreStatus status;
641                Backend backend{step, failure};
642                Require(GraphicsRestoreDetail::RestoreTargets(backend, status) == failure,
643                    "Restoration failure HRESULT lost");
644                Require(backend.visited == 4 && status.Result() == failure, "Cleanup stopped early or failure not latched");
645                const char* firstOperation = status.Operation();
646                Backend successfulCleanup{-1, S_OK};
647                Check(GraphicsRestoreDetail::RestoreTargets(successfulCleanup, status), "Later successful cleanup");
648                int commits = 0;
649                Check(GraphicsRestoreDetail::RestoreDrawingState([]() { return S_OK; }, [&]() { ++commits; }, status),
650                    "Successful state block after failed target restoration");
651                status.Record(E_ABORT, "Later failure");
652                Require(commits == 1 && status.Result() == failure && status.Operation() == firstOperation,
653                    "Later cleanup overwrote first restoration failure");
654            }
655            CGraphicsRestoreStatus status;
656            int commits = 0;
657            Require(GraphicsRestoreDetail::RestoreDrawingState([&]() { return failure; },
658                [&]() { ++commits; }, status) == failure && status.Result() == failure && commits == 0,
659                "Failed state block published saved cache");
660 
661            // No HAL device exists here. Exercise the actual owner policy without
662            // asking a driver to reset, hang or lose its device.
663            CGraphicDevice owner;
664            Require(owner.CheckRenderState(), "Fresh owner is unexpectedly blocked");
665            CGraphicsRestoreStatus::Instance().Record(failure, "Controlled owner restoration failure");
666            Require(owner.HasFatalDeviceError() && owner.AreDeviceCallbacksBlocked(), "Owner callbacks not blocked immediately");
667            owner.RecordDeviceResult(S_OK, "Controlled successful EndScene");
668            Require(!owner.CheckRenderState() && owner.PrepareFrame(false) == CGraphicDevice::FRAME_FATAL &&
669                owner.PrepareFrame(true) == CGraphicDevice::FRAME_FATAL &&
670                CGraphicsRestoreStatus::Instance().Result() == failure, "Owner resumed after restoration failure");
671            report.Write("PASS controlled restoration HRESULT=0x%08lX: all four target steps, failed Apply/cache, sticky failure, fatal owner",
672                static_cast<unsigned long>(failure));
673        }
674        Require(!CGraphicsRestoreStatus::Instance().IsBlocked(), "Device teardown did not reset restoration status");
675        CGraphicsRestoreStatus clean;
676        Backend healthy{-1, S_OK};
677        Check(GraphicsRestoreDetail::RestoreTargets(healthy, clean), "Healthy restoration");
678        Require(!clean.IsBlocked() && healthy.visited == 4, "Healthy restoration poisoned drawing");
679        report.Write("Restoration coverage: 24 target-step failures, 6 Apply/cache failures, 6 frame-owner decisions; controlled backend");
680    }

682    void RunBlockedDrawCases(IDirect3DDevice9Ex* device, Report& report)
683    {
684        Require(!CGraphicsRestoreStatus::Instance().IsBlocked(), "Unexpected failure before draw-gate test");
685        // Test-only reset after isolated scene/resource cleanup. Gameplay resets
686        // this status only when destroying/initializing its device lifetime.
687        struct ResetTestStatus { ~ResetTestStatus() { CGraphicsRestoreStatus::Instance().ResetForDeviceLifetime(); } } reset;
688        CStateManager manager(device);
689        Check(manager.GetDefaultStateResult(), "Initialize drawing defaults");
690        CScreen screen;
691        ComPtr<IDirect3DSurface9> target, readback, depth;
692        Check(device->CreateRenderTarget(4, 4, D3DFMT_A8R8G8B8, D3DMULTISAMPLE_NONE, 0,
693            FALSE, target.GetAddressOf(), nullptr), "Create draw-gate target");
694        Check(device->CreateDepthStencilSurface(4, 4, D3DFMT_D16, D3DMULTISAMPLE_NONE, 0,
695            TRUE, depth.GetAddressOf(), nullptr), "Create draw-gate depth");
696        Check(device->CreateOffscreenPlainSurface(4, 4, D3DFMT_A8R8G8B8, D3DPOOL_SYSTEMMEM,
697            readback.GetAddressOf(), nullptr), "Create draw-gate readback");
698        CRenderTargetBinding binding;
699        const D3DVIEWPORT9 viewport = {0, 0, 4, 4, 0.0f, 1.0f};
700        Check(binding.Bind(device, target.Get(), depth.Get(), viewport), "Bind draw-gate target");
701        constexpr DWORD sentinel = 0xFF2468AC;
702        Check(device->Clear(0, nullptr, D3DCLEAR_TARGET, sentinel, 1.0f, 0), "Seed draw-gate target");
703        ComPtr<IDirect3DVertexBuffer9> vertices;
704        Check(device->CreateVertexBuffer(48, 0, D3DFVF_XYZ, D3DPOOL_DEFAULT,
705            vertices.GetAddressOf(), nullptr), "Create draw-gate stream");
706        manager.SetStreamSource(0, vertices.Get(), 12);
707        Check(manager.BeginScene(), "Begin draw-gate scene");
708        struct EndTestScene
709        {
710            CStateManager& manager;
711            bool active = true;
712            ~EndTestScene() { if (active) manager.EndScene(); }
713        } scene{manager};
714        CGraphicsRestoreStatus::Instance().Record(E_ABORT, "Controlled draw-gate failure");
715        Require(manager.DrawPrimitive(D3DPT_TRIANGLELIST, 0, 1) == E_ABORT &&
716            manager.DrawPrimitiveUP(D3DPT_TRIANGLELIST, 1, nullptr, 0) == E_ABORT &&
717            manager.DrawIndexedPrimitive(D3DPT_TRIANGLELIST, 0, 3, 0, 1) == E_ABORT &&
718            manager.DrawIndexedPrimitive(D3DPT_TRIANGLELIST, 0, 0, 3, 0, 1) == E_ABORT &&
719            manager.DrawIndexedPrimitiveUP(D3DPT_TRIANGLELIST, 0, 3, 1, nullptr, D3DFMT_INDEX16, nullptr, 0) == E_ABORT,
720            "Draw entry point did not return latched failure");
721        screen.SetClearColor(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
722        screen.Clear();
723        screen.ClearDepthBuffer();
724        CStateManager::ScopedState blockedCapture(manager);
725        Require(!blockedCapture.IsValid(), "New state capture accepted while blocked");
726        CRenderTargetBinding blockedBinding;
727        Require(blockedBinding.Bind(device, target.Get(), nullptr, viewport) == E_ABORT &&
728            !blockedBinding.IsActive(), "New target pass accepted while blocked");
729        // UP draw guards must run before their usual cached-stream invalidation.
730        manager.SetStreamSource(0, nullptr, 0);
731        ComPtr<IDirect3DVertexBuffer9> actual;
732        UINT offset = 0, stride = 0;
733        Check(device->GetStreamSource(0, actual.GetAddressOf(), &offset, &stride), "Inspect draw-gate stream");
734        Require(!actual, "Blocked UP draw corrupted stream cache");
735        scene.active = false;
736        Check(manager.EndScene(), "EndScene still runs while drawing blocked");
737        Require(manager.BeginScene() == E_ABORT, "New scene accepted after restoration failure");
738        Require(screen.Show(static_cast<HWND>(nullptr)) == E_ABORT &&
739            screen.Show(static_cast<RECT*>(nullptr), nullptr) == E_ABORT, "Presentation accepted after restoration failure");
740        Check(binding.Restore(), "Target cleanup still runs while blocked");
741        Require(CGraphicsRestoreStatus::Instance().Result() == E_ABORT, "Cleanup erased draw-gate failure");
742        Check(device->GetRenderTargetData(target.Get(), readback.Get()), "Read draw-gate target");
743        D3DLOCKED_RECT locked = {};
744        Check(readback->LockRect(&locked, nullptr, D3DLOCK_READONLY), "Lock draw-gate readback");
745        bool unchanged = locked.pBits && locked.Pitch >= 16;
746        for (int y = 0; unchanged && y < 4; ++y)
747            for (int x = 0; unchanged && x < 4; ++x)
748            {
749                DWORD pixel;
750                memcpy(&pixel, static_cast<const BYTE*>(locked.pBits) + y * locked.Pitch + x * 4, sizeof(pixel));
751                unchanged = pixel == sentinel;
752            }
753        Check(readback->UnlockRect(), "Unlock draw-gate readback");
754        Require(unchanged, "Blocked drawing/clear changed render target");
755        report.Write("PASS blocked rendering: five draw paths, cache, clear/readback, new scene/pass, both presentation paths; cleanup allowed");
756    }

758    class TestPreviewGlobals : public CGraphicBase
759    {
760    public:
761        static void Set(float value)
762        {
763            D3DXMATRIX matrix;
764            D3DXMatrixTranslation(&matrix, value, value + 1, value + 2);
765            ms_matView = ms_matProj = ms_matInverseView = ms_matInverseViewYAxis =
766                ms_matWorld = ms_matWorldView = matrix;
767            ms_fFieldOfView = ms_fAspect = ms_fNearY = ms_fFarY = value;
768        }
769        static void Verify(float value)
770        {
771            D3DXMATRIX matrix;
772            D3DXMatrixTranslation(&matrix, value, value + 1, value + 2);
773            for (const auto* actual : {&ms_matView, &ms_matProj, &ms_matInverseView,
774                &ms_matInverseViewYAxis, &ms_matWorld, &ms_matWorldView})
775                Require(memcmp(actual, &matrix, sizeof(matrix)) == 0, "Preview CPU matrix leaked");
776            Require(ms_fFieldOfView == value && ms_fAspect == value && ms_fNearY == value &&
777                ms_fFarY == value, "Preview perspective parameters leaked");
778        }
779    };

781    void RunPreviewStateCases(IDirect3DDevice9Ex* device, Report& report)
782    {
783        CStateManager manager(device);
784        Check(manager.GetDefaultStateResult(), "Initialize drawing defaults");
785        CCameraManager& cameras = CCameraManager::Instance();
786        CCameraManager::ScopedCamera restoreCameras(cameras, CCameraManager::DEFAULT_PERSPECTIVE_CAMERA);
787        Require(restoreCameras.IsValid(), "Select baseline camera");
788        cameras.SetCurrentCamera(CCameraManager::DEFAULT_ORTHO_CAMERA);
789        CCamera* originalCamera = cameras.GetCurrentCamera();
790        TestPreviewGlobals::Set(17.0f);
791        manager.SetRenderState(D3DRS_FOGENABLE, TRUE);
792        manager.SetSamplerState(0, D3DSAMP_MINFILTER, D3DTEXF_POINT);
793        manager.SetTextureStageState(0, D3DTSS_COLOROP, D3DTOP_SELECTARG1);
794        D3DMATERIAL9 material = {};
795        material.Diffuse.r = 0.25f;
796        material.Diffuse.a = 1.0f;
797        manager.SetMaterial(&material);
798        D3DXMATRIX world;
799        D3DXMatrixTranslation(&world, 2, 3, 4);
800        manager.SetTransform(D3DTS_WORLD, &world);
801        ComPtr<IDirect3DTexture9> texture;
802        Check(device->CreateTexture(4, 4, 1, 0, D3DFMT_A8R8G8B8, D3DPOOL_DEFAULT,
803            texture.GetAddressOf(), nullptr), "Create state-test texture");
804        manager.SetTexture(0, texture.Get());
805        ComPtr<IDirect3DVertexBuffer9> vertices;
806        ComPtr<IDirect3DIndexBuffer9> indices;
807        Check(device->CreateVertexBuffer(48, 0, D3DFVF_XYZ, D3DPOOL_DEFAULT,
808            vertices.GetAddressOf(), nullptr), "Create state-test vertices");
809        Check(device->CreateIndexBuffer(6, 0, D3DFMT_INDEX16, D3DPOOL_DEFAULT,
810            indices.GetAddressOf(), nullptr), "Create state-test indices");
811        manager.SetStreamSource(0, vertices.Get(), 12);
812        manager.SetIndices(indices.Get(), 0);
813        manager.SetFVF(D3DFVF_XYZ);
814        const RECT scissor = {1, 2, 31, 30};
815        manager.SetScissorRect(scissor);
816        Check(manager.BeginScene(), "Begin preview state scene");
817        // End the scene even if an assertion throws.
818        struct SceneEnd
819        {
820            CStateManager& manager;
821            bool active = true;
822            ~SceneEnd() { if (active) manager.EndScene(); }
823        } scene{manager};
824        const auto earlyReturn = [&]()
825        {
826            CPreviewRenderState state(manager);
827            Require(state.IsValid(), "Capture preview drawing state");
828            CCameraManager::ScopedCamera camera(cameras, CCameraManager::SHOPDECO_CAMERA);
829            Require(camera.IsValid(), "Select preview camera");
830            manager.SetRenderState(D3DRS_FOGENABLE, FALSE);
831            manager.SetSamplerState(0, D3DSAMP_MINFILTER, D3DTEXF_LINEAR);
832            manager.SetTextureStageState(0, D3DTSS_COLOROP, D3DTOP_MODULATE);
833            D3DMATERIAL9 changed = {};
834            manager.SetMaterial(&changed);
835            manager.SetTexture(0, nullptr);
836            manager.SetStreamSource(0, nullptr, 0);
837            manager.SetIndices(nullptr, 0);
838            manager.SetFVF(D3DFVF_XYZRHW | D3DFVF_TEX1);
839            D3DXMATRIX identity;
840            D3DXMatrixIdentity(&identity);
841            manager.SetTransform(D3DTS_WORLD, &identity);
842            manager.SetScissorRect(RECT{0, 0, 16, 16});
843            TestPreviewGlobals::Set(29.0f);
844            {
845                CPreviewRenderState nested(manager);
846                Require(nested.IsValid(), "Capture nested preview state");
847                CCameraManager::ScopedCamera sameCamera(cameras, CCameraManager::SHOPDECO_CAMERA);
848                Require(sameCamera.IsValid(), "Select already-current preview camera");
849                manager.SetRenderState(D3DRS_FOGENABLE, TRUE);
850                TestPreviewGlobals::Set(43.0f);
851            }
852            TestPreviewGlobals::Verify(29.0f);
853            DWORD fog = TRUE;
854            Check(device->GetRenderState(D3DRS_FOGENABLE, &fog), "Get nested fog");
855            Require(fog == FALSE && manager.GetRenderState(D3DRS_FOGENABLE) == FALSE,
856                "Nested preview failed to restore device/cache");
857            return;
858        };
859        // Exercise the checked per-state restoration used by the shadow pass.
860        manager.SaveRenderState(D3DRS_FOGENABLE, FALSE);
861        manager.RestoreRenderState(D3DRS_FOGENABLE);
862        manager.SaveTextureStageState(0, D3DTSS_COLOROP, D3DTOP_MODULATE);
863        manager.RestoreTextureStageState(0, D3DTSS_COLOROP);
864        D3DXMATRIX identity;
865        D3DXMatrixIdentity(&identity);
866        manager.SaveTransform(D3DTS_WORLD, &identity);
867        manager.RestoreTransform(D3DTS_WORLD);
868        Require(!CGraphicsRestoreStatus::Instance().IsBlocked(), "Healthy per-state restoration blocked drawing");
869        earlyReturn();
870        TestPreviewGlobals::Verify(17.0f);
871        Require(cameras.GetCurrentCamera() == originalCamera, "Preview changed current camera");
872        cameras.ResetToPreviousCamera();
873        Require(cameras.isCurrentCamera(CCameraManager::DEFAULT_PERSPECTIVE_CAMERA),
874            "Preview consumed previous camera");
875        DWORD actual = 0, cached = 0;
876        Check(device->GetRenderState(D3DRS_FOGENABLE, &actual), "Get restored fog");
877        Require(actual == TRUE && manager.GetRenderState(D3DRS_FOGENABLE) == TRUE, "Fog leaked");
878        Check(device->GetSamplerState(0, D3DSAMP_MINFILTER, &actual), "Get restored sampler");
879        manager.GetSamplerState(0, D3DSAMP_MINFILTER, &cached);
880        Require(actual == D3DTEXF_POINT && cached == actual, "Sampler leaked");
881        Check(device->GetTextureStageState(0, D3DTSS_COLOROP, &actual), "Get restored texture stage");
882        manager.GetTextureStageState(0, D3DTSS_COLOROP, &cached);
883        Require(actual == D3DTOP_SELECTARG1 && cached == actual, "Texture stage leaked");
884        D3DMATERIAL9 actualMaterial, cachedMaterial;
885        Check(device->GetMaterial(&actualMaterial), "Get restored material");
886        manager.GetMaterial(&cachedMaterial);
887        Require(memcmp(&material, &actualMaterial, sizeof(material)) == 0 &&
888            memcmp(&material, &cachedMaterial, sizeof(material)) == 0, "Material leaked");
889        D3DXMATRIX actualWorld, cachedWorld;
890        Check(device->GetTransform(D3DTS_WORLD, &actualWorld), "Get restored world");
891        manager.GetTransform(D3DTS_WORLD, &cachedWorld);
892        Require(memcmp(&world, &actualWorld, sizeof(world)) == 0 &&
893            memcmp(&world, &cachedWorld, sizeof(world)) == 0, "World transform leaked");
894        ComPtr<IDirect3DBaseTexture9> actualTexture;
895        Check(device->GetTexture(0, actualTexture.GetAddressOf()), "Get restored texture");
896        IDirect3DBaseTexture9* cachedTexture = nullptr;
897        manager.GetTexture(0, &cachedTexture);
898        Require(actualTexture.Get() == texture.Get() && cachedTexture == texture.Get(), "Texture leaked");
899        ComPtr<IDirect3DVertexBuffer9> actualVertices;
900        UINT offset = 0, stride = 0;
901        Check(device->GetStreamSource(0, actualVertices.GetAddressOf(), &offset, &stride), "Get restored stream");
902        Require(actualVertices.Get() == vertices.Get() && offset == 0 && stride == 12, "Stream leaked");
903        ComPtr<IDirect3DIndexBuffer9> actualIndices;
904        Check(device->GetIndices(actualIndices.GetAddressOf()), "Get restored indices");
905        Require(actualIndices.Get() == indices.Get(), "Indices leaked");
906        Check(device->GetFVF(&actual), "Get restored FVF");
907        manager.GetFVF(&cached);
908        Require(actual == D3DFVF_XYZ && cached == actual, "FVF leaked");
909        RECT actualScissor;
910        Check(device->GetScissorRect(&actualScissor), "Get restored scissor");
911        Require(EqualRect(&scissor, &actualScissor) != FALSE, "Scissor leaked");
912        // Re-request the value used INSIDE the preview. A stale cache would skip it.
913        manager.SetSamplerState(0, D3DSAMP_MINFILTER, D3DTEXF_LINEAR);
914        Check(device->GetSamplerState(0, D3DSAMP_MINFILTER, &actual), "Get subsequent sampler");
915        Require(actual == D3DTEXF_LINEAR, "Stale cache suppressed next sampler update");
916        manager.SetTexture(0, nullptr);
917        manager.SetStreamSource(0, nullptr, 0);
918        manager.SetIndices(nullptr, 0);
919        actualVertices.Reset();
920        Check(device->GetStreamSource(0, actualVertices.GetAddressOf(), &offset, &stride), "Get subsequent stream");
921        Require(!actualVertices, "Stale cache suppressed next stream update");
922        actualIndices.Reset();
923        Check(device->GetIndices(actualIndices.GetAddressOf()), "Get subsequent indices");
924        Require(!actualIndices, "Stale cache suppressed next index update");
925        scene.active = false;
926        Check(manager.EndScene(), "End preview state scene");
927        report.Write("PASS preview state isolation: real device/cache, CPU matrices/perspective, nested/early-return scopes, current/previous camera, subsequent setter");
928    }

930    bool RunShaderConstantCases(IDirect3DDevice9Ex* device, const D3DCAPS9& caps, Report& report)
931    {
932        if (caps.VertexShaderVersion < D3DVS_VERSION(1, 1) || caps.PixelShaderVersion < D3DPS_VERSION(1, 1))
933        {
934            report.Write("SKIP shader constants: vertex/pixel shader 1.1 support required");
935            return false;
936        }
937        report.Write("RUN shader constant routing: device readback, no shader compilation or execution");
938        // Eight registers fit the oldest supported pixel-shader bank. Distinct,
939        // exactly representable sentinels detect wrong-stage and wrong-range writes.
940        float vertex[8][4], pixel[8][4];
941        for (unsigned reg = 0; reg < 8; ++reg)
942            for (unsigned component = 0; component < 4; ++component)
943            {
944                vertex[reg][component] = 0.125f + (reg * 4 + component) / 64.0f;
945                pixel[reg][component] = -vertex[reg][component];
946            }
947        const auto seed = [&]()
948        {
949            Check(device->SetVertexShaderConstantF(0, &vertex[0][0], 8), "Seed vertex constants");
950            Check(device->SetPixelShaderConstantF(0, &pixel[0][0], 8), "Seed pixel constants");
951        };
952        const auto verify = [&](const float* expectedVertex, const float* expectedPixel)
953        {
954            float actualVertex[8][4], actualPixel[8][4];
955            Check(device->GetVertexShaderConstantF(0, &actualVertex[0][0], 8), "Read vertex constants");
956            Check(device->GetPixelShaderConstantF(0, &actualPixel[0][0], 8), "Read pixel constants");
957            Require(memcmp(actualVertex, expectedVertex, sizeof(actualVertex)) == 0, "Vertex constant bank mismatch");
958            Require(memcmp(actualPixel, expectedPixel, sizeof(actualPixel)) == 0, "Pixel constant bank mismatch");
959        };
960        seed();
961        CStateManager manager(device);
962        Check(manager.GetDefaultStateResult(), "Initialize drawing defaults");
963        const float zero[8][4] = {};
964        verify(&zero[0][0], &zero[0][0]);
965        report.Write("PASS shader defaults: constructor clears both seeded constant banks");
966        const float replacement[2][4] = {{0.75f, 0.5f, 0.25f, 1.0f}, {-0.75f, -0.5f, -0.25f, -1.0f}};
967        const struct { UINT start, count; } ranges[] = {{0, 1}, {3, 2}, {7, 1}};
968        for (const auto& range : ranges)
969        {
970            seed();
971            float expectedPixel[8][4];
972            memcpy(expectedPixel, pixel, sizeof(pixel));
973            memcpy(expectedPixel[range.start], replacement, range.count * sizeof(replacement[0]));
974            manager.SetPixelShaderConstant(range.start, replacement, range.count);
975            verify(&vertex[0][0], &expectedPixel[0][0]);
976            seed();
977            float expectedVertex[8][4];
978            memcpy(expectedVertex, vertex, sizeof(vertex));
979            memcpy(expectedVertex[range.start], replacement, range.count * sizeof(replacement[0]));
980            manager.SetVertexShaderConstant(range.start, replacement, range.count);
981            verify(&expectedVertex[0][0], &pixel[0][0]);
982            report.Write("PASS shader routing: start=%u count=%u; opposite bank and neighboring registers preserved", range.start, range.count);
983        }
984        seed();
985        {
986            CStateManager::ScopedState state(manager);
987            Require(state.IsValid(), "Capture shader constants");
988            manager.SetPixelShaderConstant(3, replacement, 2);
989            manager.SetVertexShaderConstant(3, replacement, 2);
990            Check(state.Restore(), "Restore shader constants");
991        }
992        verify(&vertex[0][0], &pixel[0][0]);
993        report.Write("PASS shader constant scope: both banks restored");
994        Check(manager.SetDefaultState(), "Reinitialize drawing defaults");
995        verify(&zero[0][0], &zero[0][0]);
996        report.Write("PASS shader defaults: repeated initialization clears both seeded banks");
997        report.Write("Shader coverage: 6 stage/range writes, constructor/repeated defaults, scoped restoration; real device state readback");
998        return true;
999    }

1018        }

1037                Check(manager.SetSamplerState(stage, type, D3DTEXF_POINT), "Set point sampler after rejection");
1038                verify(stage, type, D3DTEXF_POINT);
1039                manager.SaveSamplerState(stage, type, D3DTEXF_LINEAR);
1040                manager.SaveSamplerState(stage, type, D3DTEXF_POINT);
1041                manager.RestoreSamplerState(stage, type);
1042                verify(stage, type, D3DTEXF_LINEAR);

1048        }

1050            manager.SetSamplerState(0, static_cast<D3DSAMPLERSTATETYPE>(0), 0) == D3DERR_INVALIDCALL &&
1051            manager.SetSamplerState(0, static_cast<D3DSAMPLERSTATETYPE>(0x7fffffff), 0) == D3DERR_INVALIDCALL,

1101        };

1192    void RunGeometryBufferCases(IDirect3DDevice9Ex* device, Report& report)
1193    {
1194        struct Buffer
1195        {
1196            BYTE data[16] = {};
1197            HRESULT lockResult = S_OK, unlockResult = S_OK;
1198            bool nullData = false;
1199            unsigned locks = 0, unlocks = 0;
1200            HRESULT Lock(UINT, UINT, void** output, DWORD flags)
1201            {
1202                ++locks;
1203                Require(flags == 0, "Geometry copy requested a read-only/discard lock");
1204                *output = nullData ? nullptr : data;
1205                return lockResult;
1206            }
1207            HRESULT Unlock() { ++unlocks; return unlockResult; }
1208        };
1209        const DWORD payload[4] = {1, 2, 3, 4};
1210        for (int fault = 0; fault < 3; ++fault)
1211        {
1212            Buffer buffer;
1213            if (fault == 0) buffer.lockResult = D3DERR_INVALIDCALL;
1214            if (fault == 1) buffer.nullData = true;
1215            if (fault == 2) buffer.unlockResult = E_FAIL;
1216            Require(!GeometryBufferUpload::Copy(&buffer, 16, 16, payload), "Failed geometry upload reported success");
1217            Require(buffer.locks == 1 && buffer.unlocks == (fault == 0 ? 0u : 1u), "Geometry lock cleanup mismatch");
1218            buffer.lockResult = buffer.unlockResult = S_OK; buffer.nullData = false;
1219            Require(GeometryBufferUpload::Copy(&buffer, 16, 16, payload) && memcmp(buffer.data, payload, 16) == 0, "Geometry retry/copy mismatch");

1450int RunGraphicsSelfTest(HINSTANCE instance)
1451{
1452    Report report;
1453    if (!report.IsOpen())
1454    {
1455        MessageBoxW(nullptr, L"Could not create the graphics self-test report in the working directory's log folder.",

1457        return 2;
1458    }
1459    int result = 1;
1460    try
1461    {
1462        report.Write("Metin2 DX9Ex graphics self-test v10; build %s %s; pointer bits=%zu", __DATE__, __TIME__, sizeof(void*) * 8);
1463        report.Write("Standalone HAL upload/render/readback test. No login, packs, or game state.");
1464        RunControlledCases(report);
1465        RunControlledRestoreCases(report);
1466        result = RunCases(instance, report);
1467    }
1468    catch (const std::exception& error)
1469    {
1470        report.Write("FAIL: %s", error.what());
1471    }
1472    catch (...)
1473    {
1474        report.Write("FAIL: unexpected C++ exception");
1475    }
1476    // RunCases has destroyed all test resources and the device before this result.
1477    if (result == 0)
1478        report.Write("RESULT: PASS");
1479    else if (result == 3)
1480        report.Write("RESULT: INCOMPLETE (unsupported capability cases were skipped)");
1481    else

1483    return report.WriteFailed() ? 2 : result;

nn242void CGraphicDevice::RecordDeviceResult(HRESULT result, const char* operation)
243{
244    if (!CheckRenderState())
245        return;
246 
247    if (result != m_deviceResult)
248    {
249        if (FAILED(result))
250            TraceError("Graphics: %s returned %s (HRESULT=0x%08lX, windowed=%d, backbuffer=%ux%u)",
251                operation, DeviceResultName(result), static_cast<unsigned long>(result), ms_d3dPresentParameter.Windowed,
252                ms_d3dPresentParameter.BackBufferWidth, ms_d3dPresentParameter.BackBufferHeight);
253        else
254            Tracenf("Graphics: %s returned %s (0x%08lX)", operation, DeviceResultName(result), static_cast<unsigned long>(result));
255    }
256    m_deviceResult = result;
257 
258    if (result == S_PRESENT_MODE_CHANGED)
259        m_resetPending = true;
260    else if (result == D3DERR_DEVICELOST)
261    {
262        m_resetPending = true;
263        if (!m_recovering)
264        {
265            m_recovering = true;
266            m_recoveryStartTime = GetTickCount();
267        }
268    }
269    else if (result != S_OK && result != S_PRESENT_OCCLUDED)
270    {
271        // A hung device can have lost texture contents; a removed device needs
272        // full recreation. Neither is repaired by a presentation-only reset.
273        m_fatalDeviceError = true;
274        TraceError("Graphics: stopping client loop; %s returned 0x%08lX. Restart required.",
275            operation, static_cast<unsigned long>(result));
276    }
277}

279bool CGraphicDevice::CheckRenderState()
280{
281    const auto& status = CGraphicsRestoreStatus::Instance();
282    if (!m_fatalDeviceError && status.IsBlocked())
283    {
284        m_deviceResult = status.Result();
285        m_fatalDeviceError = true;
286        TraceError("Graphics: stopping client loop after %s (HRESULT=0x%08lX). Restart required.",
287            status.Operation(), static_cast<unsigned long>(status.Result()));
288    }
289    return !m_fatalDeviceError;
290}

292CGraphicDevice::EFrameStatus CGraphicDevice::PrepareFrame(bool minimized)
293{
294    if (!CheckRenderState() || !ms_lpd3dDevice)
295        return FRAME_FATAL;
296    if (m_resetInProgress)
297        return FRAME_RETRY;
298 
299    const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
300    if (m_recovering && now - m_recoveryStartTime >= DeviceRecoveryTimeoutMs)
301    {
302        TraceError("Graphics: recovery timed out after %lu ms; stopping client loop.", DeviceRecoveryTimeoutMs);
303        m_fatalDeviceError = true;
304        return FRAME_FATAL;
305    }
306 
307    // Healthy frames do not poll the driver. Occlusion and transient loss are
308    // checked at a bounded rate after presentation/scene/reset reports trouble.
309    if (m_deviceResult != S_OK)
310    {
311        if (now - m_lastDeviceCheckTime < DeviceCheckIntervalMs)
312            return m_recovering ? FRAME_RETRY : FRAME_SKIP_RENDER;
313 
314        m_lastDeviceCheckTime = now;
315        RecordDeviceResult(ms_lpd3dDevice->CheckDeviceState(ms_hWnd), "CheckDeviceState");
316        if (m_fatalDeviceError)
317            return FRAME_FATAL;
318        // DEVICELOST after a failed reset requires another ResetEx attempt;
319        // waiting for the obsolete DEVICENOTRESET status would never recover.
320        if (m_deviceResult == S_PRESENT_OCCLUDED)
321            return m_recovering ? FRAME_RETRY : FRAME_SKIP_RENDER;
322    }
323 
324    if (minimized)
325        return m_recovering ? FRAME_RETRY : FRAME_SKIP_RENDER;
326 
327    if (m_resetPending && !__ResetPending())
328        return m_fatalDeviceError ? FRAME_FATAL : FRAME_RETRY;
329 
330    m_recovering = false;
331    return FRAME_READY;
332}

7// Internal upload transaction shared by Direct3D and the standalone test backend.
8// Backend owns the API operations; this function owns temporary resources.
9// Release must not throw. A successful Create/Lock must return usable storage.
10namespace TextureUploadDetail
11{
12    // A decoded RGBA image is tightly packed and contains exactly one level.
13    // Publish the destination only after every allocation/copy has succeeded.
14    template <class Backend>
15    HRESULT UploadRGBA8(Backend& backend, const TDecodedImageData& image,
16        typename Backend::Texture** output)
17    {
18        if (!output)
19            return E_INVALIDARG;
20        *output = nullptr;
21        using Texture = typename Backend::Texture;
22        auto release = [&backend](Texture* texture) noexcept { backend.Release(texture); };
23        using TexturePtr = std::unique_ptr<Texture, decltype(release)>;
24        if (image.width <= 0 || image.height <= 0 || image.mipLevels != 1)
25            return E_INVALIDARG;
26 
27        const size_t width = static_cast<size_t>(image.width);
28        const size_t height = static_cast<size_t>(image.height);
29        const size_t maxSize = (std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max)();
30        if (width > maxSize / 4)
31            return E_INVALIDARG;
32        const size_t rowBytes = width * 4;
33        if (rowBytes > static_cast<size_t>((std::numeric_limits<INT>::max)()) ||
34            height > maxSize / rowBytes || image.pixels.size() != rowBytes * height)
35            return E_INVALIDARG;
36 
37        Texture* raw = nullptr;
38        HRESULT result = backend.Create(image.width, image.height, D3DPOOL_SYSTEMMEM, &raw);
39        TexturePtr staging(raw, release);
40        if (FAILED(result))
41            return result;
42 
43        D3DLOCKED_RECT locked = {};
44        result = backend.Lock(staging.get(), &locked);
45        if (FAILED(result))
46            return result;
47 
48        if (!locked.pBits || locked.Pitch <= 0 || static_cast<size_t>(locked.Pitch) < rowBytes ||
49            height > maxSize / static_cast<size_t>(locked.Pitch))
50        {
51            backend.Unlock(staging.get());
52            return E_FAIL;
53        }
54 
55        for (size_t y = 0; y < height; ++y)
56        {
57            const uint8_t* source = image.pixels.data() + y * rowBytes;
58            uint8_t* destination = static_cast<uint8_t*>(locked.pBits) + y * locked.Pitch;
59            for (size_t x = 0; x < rowBytes; x += 4)
60            {
61                // RGBA bytes -> little-endian A8R8G8B8 (BGRA bytes).
62                destination[x] = source[x + 2];
63                destination[x + 1] = source[x + 1];
64                destination[x + 2] = source[x];
65                destination[x + 3] = source[x + 3];
66            }
67        }
68 
69        result = backend.Unlock(staging.get());
70        if (FAILED(result))
71            return result;
72 
73        raw = nullptr;
74        result = backend.Create(image.width, image.height, D3DPOOL_DEFAULT, &raw);
75        TexturePtr destination(raw, release);
76        if (FAILED(result))
77            return result;
78        // The write lock marks level zero dirty. Both textures have the same
79        // dimensions, format, and level count as required by UpdateTexture.
80        result = backend.Update(staging.get(), destination.get());
81        if (FAILED(result))
82            return result;
83 
84        *output = destination.release();
85        return S_OK;
86    }
87}

8// Single-threaded, balanced offscreen pass. Only target/depth/viewport state;

10class CRenderTargetBinding
11{
12public:
13    CRenderTargetBinding() = default;

17    bool IsActive() const { return m_device != nullptr; }
18 
19    HRESULT Bind(IDirect3DDevice9* device, IDirect3DSurface9* target,
20        IDirect3DSurface9* depth, const D3DVIEWPORT9& viewport)
21    {
22        if (CGraphicsRestoreStatus::Instance().IsBlocked()) return CGraphicsRestoreStatus::Instance().Result();
23        if (!device || !target || IsActive()) return D3DERR_INVALIDCALL;
24        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDirect3DSurface9> previousTarget, previousDepth;
25        D3DVIEWPORT9 previousViewport = {};
26        HRESULT result = device->GetRenderTarget(0, previousTarget.GetAddressOf());
27        if (FAILED(result)) return Log(result, "GetRenderTarget");
28        result = device->GetDepthStencilSurface(previousDepth.GetAddressOf());
29        if (FAILED(result) && result != D3DERR_NOTFOUND) return Log(result, "GetDepthStencilSurface");
30        result = device->GetViewport(&previousViewport);
31        if (FAILED(result)) return Log(result, "GetViewport");
32        m_target = previousTarget;
33        m_depth = previousDepth;
34        m_viewport = previousViewport;
35        m_device = device;
36        // Detach depth first to avoid a transient mismatch of size/MSAA settings.
37        result = device->SetDepthStencilSurface(nullptr);
38        if (SUCCEEDED(result)) result = device->SetRenderTarget(0, target);
39        if (SUCCEEDED(result)) result = device->SetDepthStencilSurface(depth);
40        if (SUCCEEDED(result)) result = device->SetViewport(&viewport);
41        if (FAILED(result))
42        {
43            Log(result, "Bind");
44            const HRESULT restore = Restore();
45            return FAILED(restore) ? restore : result;
46        }
47        return S_OK;
48    }
49 
50    HRESULT Restore()
51    {
52        if (!IsActive()) return S_OK;
53        struct Backend
54        {
55            IDirect3DDevice9* device;
56            IDirect3DSurface9* target;
57            IDirect3DSurface9* depth;
58            const D3DVIEWPORT9& viewport;
59            HRESULT DetachDepth() { return device->SetDepthStencilSurface(nullptr); }
60            HRESULT RestoreTarget() { return device->SetRenderTarget(0, target); }
61            HRESULT RestoreDepth() { return device->SetDepthStencilSurface(depth); }
62            HRESULT RestoreViewport() { return device->SetViewport(&viewport); }
63        } backend{m_device.Get(), m_target.Get(), m_depth.Get(), m_viewport};
64        const HRESULT firstFailure = GraphicsRestoreDetail::RestoreTargets(backend, CGraphicsRestoreStatus::Instance());
65        m_device.Reset();
66        m_target.Reset();
67        m_depth.Reset();
68        return firstFailure;
69    }
